market_outlook.short_term: Elevated volatility into Friday's $7T triple witching. Fed hike and Saudi oil withholding create headwinds for equities. Tech outperforms cyclicals. Yen carry unwind pressures global risk assets. Expect 2-3% S&P 500 range-bound trading with sector rotation favoring tech, energy, and short-duration bonds.
market_outlook.long_term: Fed rate cycle restart implies 1-2 more hikes through 2027, pressuring multiples. Oil supply tightness supports energy sector for 6-12 months. AI capex cycle remains intact but regulatory fragmentation (CLARITY failure, House Russia bill) adds uncertainty. Buffett succession may shift BRK toward more passive allocation. Housing market remains frozen at 7% rates. Japan normalization continues, reducing EM liquidity.
